name: Example help
description: This plugin's Help mode entries (help@1). Every screen, button, switch and setting the plugin draws gets one: a short title and a plain sentence on what it does, when to use it and what happens if you tap it. Draft new ones from the code with `node framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft console-web`, then edit them and drop `draft`.
author: Brett
